course: Kubernetes for DevOps — Zero to Production

modules.title: Kubernetes Foundation — The 3 Whys and Docker vs Kubernetes
modules.outcome: Explain why Kubernetes exists before touching YAML.

modules.title: Kubernetes Architecture — Control Plane and Worker Nodes
modules.outcome: Draw the cluster and explain what happens after kubectl apply.

modules.title: kubectl, YAML and the First Pod
modules.outcome: Read manifests and create, inspect and delete a Pod.

modules.title: Pods — Lifecycle, Multi-Container Patterns and Debugging
modules.outcome: Understand Pod lifecycle, container states and multi-container patterns.

modules.title: ReplicaSets and Deployments — Self-Healing, Scaling and Rollouts
modules.outcome: Run a replicated app and safely update/rollback it.

modules.title: Labels, Selectors and Namespaces
modules.outcome: Organize objects and understand how Kubernetes resources find each other.

modules.title: Services and DNS — Stable Networking and Discovery
modules.outcome: Expose Pods through a stable Service and use DNS.

modules.title: ConfigMaps and Secrets
modules.outcome: Externalize application configuration and sensitive values.

modules.title: Probes, Resource Requests/Limits and QoS
modules.outcome: Teach Kubernetes when an app is started, ready, healthy and how much resource it needs.

modules.title: Kubernetes Storage — Volumes, PV, PVC and StorageClass
modules.outcome: Understand ephemeral and persistent storage.

modules.title: Workload Controllers — DaemonSet, StatefulSet, Job and CronJob
modules.outcome: Choose the correct controller for each workload type.

modules.title: Kubernetes Scheduling — Placement and Topology
modules.outcome: Control where Pods can or should run.

modules.title: ServiceAccounts and RBAC
modules.outcome: Implement namespace-scoped least privilege.

modules.title: Kubernetes Networking — Pod, Service, CNI and DNS
modules.outcome: Trace Pod-to-Pod, Pod-to-Service and DNS traffic.

modules.title: NetworkPolicies — East-West Traffic Control
modules.outcome: Move from default allow toward explicit workload communication.

modules.title: Ingress and TLS
modules.outcome: Route HTTP traffic and understand controller responsibility.

modules.title: Autoscaling and Availability — HPA, PDB and Node Scaling
modules.outcome: Scale Pods and protect capacity during voluntary disruption.

modules.title: Helm — Package Kubernetes Applications
modules.outcome: Convert the progressive app into a reusable Helm chart.

modules.title: Monitoring, Logging and Troubleshooting
modules.outcome: Use a repeatable incident workflow.

modules.title: Kubernetes Security
modules.outcome: Apply baseline workload, identity, network and supply-chain controls.

modules.title: Day-2 Operations — Maintenance, Upgrades and Recovery
modules.outcome: Operate an existing cluster after installation.

cluster_tracks: kubeadm on EC2 — Self-Managed / On-Premises Simulation
